name: The Lost Sheep
overview: The theme of the lost sheep reveals God's compassionate pursuit of those who have gone astray, as illustrated by the Psalmist's confession of wandering like a lost sheep and God's command to seek His servant (Psalms 119:176). Jesus emphasizes His mission to the lost sheep of Israel (Matthew 15:24) and teaches through the parable that the shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to seek the one who has wandered, underscoring the Father's desire that none should perish (Matthew 18:12, 14). This narrative is set against the backdrop of sinners and publicans drawing near to hear Jesus, highlighting His heart for the lost (Luke 15:1-3).
